dataset.name: synthetic-original
dataset.description: Original synthetic support corpus (41 documents, 21 questions; mostly Spanish documents with Spanish and English questions).
notes: Entirely invented documents and questions; no real people, customers or companies.
The 'heldout' questions here were inspected while developing the private v1 pipeline; treat them as regression evidence, not an untouched held-out set.

pipeline.fts: simple ∪ spanish ∪ english tsvector; websearch_to_tsquery; ts_rank_cd

caveats: Small benchmark: one sample per question and mode; differences of one question move split means by 1/n.
Ranking metrics use binary relevance over evidence ids; repeated evidence earns no extra credit.
Retrieval only: no answer generation, so context quality is a proxy for downstream answer quality.
